advisories.summary_en: Ollama before 0.1.34 does not validate the digest format when resolving the model path, mishandling cases such as fewer or more than 64 hex digits and allowing path traversal / arbitrary file access through the pull/blob API.
advisories.summary_zh: Ollama 0.1.34 之前版本在解析模型路径时未校验 digest 格式，可导致路径穿越/任意文件读取。
